name: context-builder
description: Builds focused context for LLM consumption by selecting relevant files based on a task description. Uses heuristic scoring (keyword matching, import tracing, file proximity) to stay within a token budget. Deterministic — no LLM needed.

inputs.name: Project Directory
inputs.description: Path to the project root directory

inputs.name: Task Description
inputs.description: Natural language description of the task (used for keyword extraction and relevance scoring)

inputs.name: Max Tokens
inputs.description: Maximum token budget for the context (default: 1500). Approximate — uses 4 chars/token heuristic.

inputs.name: Focus Files
inputs.description: Comma-separated list of file paths to prioritize (relative to project dir)

inputs.name: Include Conventions
inputs.description: Set to 'true' to include project conventions summary (default: true)

outputs.name: Context
outputs.description: The assembled context string ready for LLM consumption

outputs.name: Selected Files
outputs.description: Array of selected file paths with their relevance scores

outputs.name: Token Estimate
outputs.description: Estimated token count of the assembled context

outputs.name: Summary
outputs.description: Brief description of what was included in the context
